model_type: TensorFlow Lite MobileNetV3 Small, 13-class image classifier

input.resize: Resize shortest edge to 256 pixels with bilinear interpolation, then center crop 224x224
input.normalization: The model includes Keras MobileNetV3 rescaling from [0,255] to [-1,1]; callers must not apply ImageNet mean/std normalization.

output.interpretation: 13 softmax probabilities in labels order; outputs sum approximately to 1
output.confidence: Top softmax value is classifier confidence only; it is not a calibrated probability, nutrition factor, or portion estimate.
